infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BudgetSplit can optionally tag a transaction with where you made it. This is off by default and never leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BudgetSplit uses the camera so you can photograph a receipt and attach it to an expense. Photos are stored on your device and never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BudgetSplit needs access to your photos so you can attach a receipt to an expense or set a profile picture. Photos are stored on your device and never uploaded.
